title: 第8章 荒唐的交易
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
“苏冰。”苏冰语气平淡说，没有多余的表情。

    陈阳点了点头，眼神里的疑惑更甚：“苏冰姐，是你把我送到医院来的？”

    苏冰轻轻点了点头，没有说话，只是静静地看着他。

    陈阳心里越发疑惑，他与苏冰根本没有任何往来，甚至连名字都是刚刚才知道，她怎么会知道自己的住处？

    还特意把自己送到医院来？

    难道……她是来找自己负责的？

    就在陈阳胡思乱想的时候，苏冰突然开口，语气带着几分暧昧，眼神直直地盯着他：“你喜不喜欢姐？”

    陈阳彻底愣住了，眼睛瞪得圆圆的，满脸都是意外，完全不明白苏冰为什么会突然问出这样的话，一时竟不知该如何回答。

    苏冰见状，非但没有收敛，反而往前凑了凑，语气更加大胆，带着几分诱惑：“你想不想再睡姐？”

    陈阳直直地看着她，眼神里满是震惊和茫然，一时之间，完全摸不透苏冰的心思，不知道她这样说，到底是在试探自己，还是另有目的。

    苏冰见他一脸迟疑，以为他在怀疑自己的诚意，当即不再犹豫，在病床边的凳子上坐了下来。

    她抬起一条腿，腿上裹着一层薄如蝉翼的黑色丝袜，丝袜紧紧贴在肌肤上，勾勒出腿纤细流畅的线条。

    白皙的肌肤透过丝袜隐隐可见，脚踝纤细精致，黑色的高跟鞋衬得她的腿愈发修长。

    她将这只裹着黑丝的脚轻轻放在陈阳的大腿上，然后缓缓往上游走，动作暧昧又带着几分挑衅。

    陈阳看着她性感的双腿，感受着大腿上传来的细腻触感和微微的磨蹭，整个人都傻眼了，大脑一片空白，心跳瞬间加速，脸颊也微微泛红，下意识地绷紧了身体。

    苏冰自己也有些惊讶，她一向高冷自持，从来没有做过如此大胆无耻的举动。

    可看着陈阳这副模样，再想起前天晚上的屈辱，她心底的报复欲和一丝莫名的情绪交织在一起，让她忍不住想要试探他。

    苏冰嘴角勾起一抹淡淡的笑意，语气带着几分诱惑和条件：“只要你答应姐一件事，姐就让你再上一次。”

    陈阳这才回过神，连忙伸手抓住她的脚，将她的动作停下，语气带着几分尴尬和认真：“冰姐，你别这样。

    我们前天晚上之所以发生关系，是因为我喝醉了，而你又被下了药，都是意外。
content_en:
"Su Bing." Su Bing said calmly, without any unnecessary expression.

Chen Yang nodded, his eyes even more confused: "Sister Su Bing, was it you who sent me to the hospital?"

Su Bing nodded slightly, did not speak, and just looked at him quietly.

Chen Yang became more and more confused. He had no contact with Su Bing at all. He even knew his name just now. How could she know where he lived?

And you even sent yourself to the hospital specially?

Could it be that...she came to take responsibility for herself?

Just when Chen Yang was thinking wildly, Su Bing suddenly spoke, with a somewhat ambiguous tone, staring straight at him: "Do you like sister?"

Chen Yang was completely stunned, his eyes were round and his face was full of surprise. He had no idea why Su Bing suddenly asked such a question, and he didn't know how to answer for a moment.

When Su Bing saw this, instead of restraining herself, she moved forward and spoke in a bolder and more seductive tone: "Do you want to sleep with me again?"

Chen Yang looked straight at her, his eyes full of shock and confusion. For a moment, he couldn't figure out Su Bing's thoughts at all. He didn't know if she was testing him by saying this, or if she had another purpose.

Seeing his hesitation, Su Bing thought he was doubting her sincerity, so she immediately stopped hesitating and sat down on the stool beside the hospital bed.

She raised one leg, which was wrapped in a thin layer of black stockings. The stockings stuck tightly to her skin, outlining the slender and smooth lines of her legs.

Her fair skin was faintly visible through her stockings, her ankles were slender and delicate, and her black high-heeled shoes made her legs even longer.

She gently placed her foot wrapped in black stockings on Chen Yang's thigh, and then slowly walked upstream, her movements ambiguous and a bit provocative.

Chen Yang looked at her sexy legs and felt the delicate touch and slight friction on her thighs. He was dumbfounded, his mind went blank, his heartbeat accelerated instantly, his cheeks turned slightly red, and he subconsciously tensed up his body.

Su Bing herself was a little surprised. She had always been aloof and reserved, and had never done such a bold and shameless move.

But looking at Chen Yang's appearance, and then thinking about the humiliation the night before, the desire for revenge in her heart was intertwined with a trace of inexplicable emotions, making her unable to help but want to test him.

A faint smile appeared on Su Bing's lips, and her tone was somewhat seductive and conditional: "As long as you promise me one thing, I will let you do it again."

Only then did Chen Yang come back to his senses, and quickly reached out to grab her feet, stopping her movement, and said with a bit of embarrassment and seriousness in his tone: "Sister Bing, don't do this.

The reason we had sex the night before was because I was drunk and you were drugged. It was all accidental.
